Gaps of 1–2" between ledges are crossed by Jump, and a failed Jump into the Chasm causes a Chasm Fall, with stated exceptions for Fly or Climb Speeds (see 10.4).
semantic_check: 3" map and stone distances, 8" Chasm, 1" wide ledges, 1-2" gaps requiring Jump, 1-2 Crumbling ledges and Speed -1" from 12965-12969; Jump cost 2" per 1" and DEX Check from 4.4.9; failed Jump into the Chasm = Chasm Fall, removed from play, Hero Defeated with a normal Injuries Roll, carried items including the Survey Map lost, replacing normal Falling (13003-13005); victory = Hero places the Survey Map adjacent to the Stone (13011).
